page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is a storage-focused cloud instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware configuration features 16 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. Memory allocation total 64.0 GB RAM, providing a standard balance of 4.0 GB per core. The instance is configured with a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

A primary feature of the ecs.d1.4xlarge is its integrated local storage solution, offering 47244 GB of local hard disk drive (HDD) capacity. Provisioning large local HDD storage delivers high storage density directly attached to the virtual machine. However, using mechanical HDDs rather than solid-state drives involves tradeoffs in access latency and random input/output throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, bundling extensive local storage capacity yields favorable resource density for sequential data access patterns. The ecs.d1.4xlarge is suitable for big data analytics, log collection, distributed file systems, data warehousing, and batch processing workloads that require massive local disk capacity.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is a dedicated storage-dense cloud server running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, it provides 16 x86_64 vCPUs and 64.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive bundled local storage capacity of 47244 GB delivered via HDD media, paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. While the mechanical HDD storage introduces latency tradeoffs compared to modern NVMe drives, it offers substantial density for high-volume data retention. The server is well suited for big data analytics, log processing, data warehousing, and distributed storage systems where bulk disk capacity is prioritized over random I/O performance.
